hero.lead: Q2M builds AI agents, intelligent automation and smart-glasses apps for automotive, insurance, health, real estate, fintech and BPO teams. We take a use case from first workshop to a system your people use every day.

bts.title: Bring one process. Leave with an AI plan for it.
paras: Book a 30-minute session at our stand. Tell us where work piles up, and we will map an AI agent or automation that fits your systems, with a rough scope and timeline.

To get the most from the session, bring a short description of the process, the systems it touches and a sample document or screenshot if you can share one. If you are not sure where AI fits yet, come for the demos: try the smart glasses, watch an agent work through a stack of documents and ask the team anything.

services.title: What we build
services.intro: Seven practices, one team. Most projects combine two or three: an agent that reads documents, a dashboard that tracks it, and the cloud setup that keeps it running. Because one team covers all of them, you have one partner to call when something needs to change.

items.title: AI smart glasses app development
items.text: Smart glasses put instructions, cameras and an AI assistant in front of the people who work with their hands. We build apps that let a technician see the next step of an inspection, call a remote expert who sees what they see, and capture photos and video without stopping work. We build for Meta, XREAL, Snap Spectacles and MentraOS glasses, and we pick the device that suits the job, the budget and the environment.
ticks: Remote expert calls with live video from the wearer
Photo, video and voice notes tagged to the job
AI that reads labels, parts and damage in view

items.title: Agentic AI and intelligent automation
items.text: Many back-office tasks follow the same pattern: read something, check it against a rule or a system, decide, then update a record. We build agents that run these tasks end to end across email, documents, CRM and ERP. People stay in charge of the steps that carry risk, approving or correcting what the agent proposes.
ticks: Audit trail for every action an agent takes

items.title: AI agent development
items.text: Custom agents for support, sales operations, claims, onboarding and internal knowledge. Each agent is connected to your own data and tools, scoped to a clear job, and tested against real examples from your business before it goes live.
ticks: Connections to your CRM, ticketing and databases
Evaluation sets built from your real cases

items.title: Agentic commerce (ACP/UCP) readiness
items.text: Shoppers are starting to ask AI assistants to find and buy products for them. New protocols such as ACP and UCP define how those agents read a catalogue and complete a checkout. We review your product data, policies and checkout flow and make the changes needed so agents can find, compare and buy from you.
ticks: Checkout and policy changes for agent buyers

items.title: 3D Gaussian splatting
items.text: Gaussian splatting turns ordinary phone or camera video into a photoreal 3D scene that runs in a web browser or headset. It suits property tours, site records, vehicle condition reports and training material, where a flat photo leaves too much out.
ticks: Measurements and annotations in the scene

items.title: MLOps
items.text: A model that works in a demo can drift once real data arrives. We set up the deployment, monitoring and retraining pipelines that keep models accurate and costs predictable after launch, on the cloud you already use.
ticks: Monitoring for accuracy, drift and cost

items.title: Microsoft business apps
items.text: If your company runs on Microsoft 365, the fastest route to AI is often through the tools your staff already open every day. We build Power Platform apps, Dynamics 365 extensions and Copilot solutions that fit your existing licences and security setup.
ticks: Power Apps and Power Automate flows

industries.title: Where we work
industries.intro: We start from the workflow, not the model. These are the problems we are asked about most in each sector.

items.name: Automotive
items.text: Dealers, workshops and plants run inspections that depend on a trained eye and a paper checklist. We build smart-glasses apps and vision models that guide each check, spot damage and log results with photos, so reports are consistent from one technician to the next.

items.name: Insurance
items.text: Claims arrive as emails, scanned forms, photos and phone notes. Our agents read each one, pull out the key fields, check them against the policy and route the claim to the right handler, with a summary ready before anyone opens the file.

items.name: Life sciences, health and biotech
items.text: Clinical, lab and quality teams spend hours moving data between records. We build document AI that extracts and checks that data, flags gaps for review and keeps a clear record of what was changed and by whom.

items.name: Real estate
items.text: A 3D capture lets a buyer walk through a property before they visit. We turn phone video into browser tours and pair them with assistants that answer enquiries, book viewings and keep listings up to date.

items.name: Fintech
items.text: Onboarding and reconciliation involve many small checks across documents and systems. We automate the routine checks, send the exceptions to a person with the evidence attached, and keep the full trail for audit.

items.name: BPO
items.text: Contact centres handle thousands of conversations a day. We build analytics that show why customers get in touch, and agents that draft replies, route tickets and hand complex cases to the right team.

about.title: A young AI company built around delivery
paras: Q2M Solutions is an Indian startup that turns AI ideas into working software. Our team combines engineers who build agents and data pipelines, developers who ship apps for smart glasses and XR headsets, and consultants who understand how operations teams actually work.

We started Q2M because we saw the same pattern again and again: companies run AI experiments that impress in a meeting and then stall. The model is rarely the problem. The hard parts are the connection to real systems, the handling of messy data, the approval steps that keep people comfortable, and the monitoring that keeps the system honest after launch. That is the work we focus on.

We work best with operations, IT and innovation leaders who have a specific process in mind and want to see it run with AI in weeks rather than plan it for a year. Whether you are a large enterprise, a global capability centre or a growing company, the approach is the same: pick one process, prove the value, then scale what works.

team.title: The people you will work with
team.intro: You meet the people who will design and build your system, at the stand and in every workshop after it.

approach.title: From first workshop to a system people use
approach.intro: Every project moves through the same four stages. You can stop after any stage and keep what we have produced.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.text: We sit with the people who do the work today and map one process from start to finish: the inputs, the systems, the decisions and where time is lost. You get a written use-case brief with the expected benefit, the data needed and the risks.
steps.out: You get: use-case brief, process map, data review

steps.title: Pilot
steps.text: We build a working version on a small slice of real data and put it in front of a few users. The pilot is measured against the goals set in discovery, so the decision to go further is based on results.
steps.out: You get: working pilot, results report, production plan

steps.title: Production
steps.text: We harden the pilot: security review, connections to your live systems, monitoring, access control and training for the team. It goes live in stages, with a person approving critical steps until the numbers show it can run on its own.
steps.out: You get: live system, monitoring, user training

steps.title: Run and improve
steps.text: After launch we watch accuracy, cost and usage, retrain models when data changes and add the next use case. You can run it yourselves with our documentation, or keep us on a support plan.
steps.out: You get: support, retraining, a roadmap of next use cases

principles.title: What you can expect from us
principles.intro: We are a young company, so we keep our promises small and specific.

items.title: One process at a time
items.text: We start with a single workflow that matters to you, prove it works and then expand. Large AI programmes often stall when they try to change everything at once. A small win builds the trust and the data you need for the next one.

items.title: Your data stays yours
items.text: We build on your cloud or ours under clear terms, use your access rules and sign an NDA before we see anything sensitive. Nothing you share is used to train public models, and you can ask us to delete working copies at the end of a project.

items.title: People in the loop
items.text: Agents propose and people approve wherever a mistake would be costly. As confidence grows, you decide which steps can run on their own. The controls stay in your hands, not ours.

items.title: Plain reporting
items.text: Each stage ends with a short written report: what we built, what it measured, what it cost and what we recommend next. We avoid jargon and report the measures your finance and operations teams already use.

session.title: How a session at our stand works
session.intro: No slides about AI in general. We talk about one process in your business.

steps.title: You walk us through one process
steps.text: Who does it today, which systems it touches, how many cases you handle and where time or errors pile up.

steps.title: We map the AI use case

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Something else on your mind? Ask us at the stand or in the booking form below.

a: Q2M Solutions is an AI engineering company based in India. We design and build AI agents, intelligent automation, smart-glasses apps and 3D capture solutions for businesses in automotive, insurance, life sciences, real estate, fintech and BPO.

items.q: What happens in the 30-minute session at BTS?
a: You describe one process in your business. We ask questions, sketch how an AI agent, an automation or a smart-glasses app could handle it, and show a live demo of something similar where we have one. You leave with a rough scope and a suggested pilot. There is no charge and no obligation.

items.q: Do we need clean data before we start?
a: No. Most companies have data spread across email, PDFs, spreadsheets and several systems. Part of discovery is finding out what data exists, what state it is in and what the first version can work with. We tell you plainly if a use case needs more preparation first.

items.q: How long does a pilot take?
a: It depends on the process and the systems involved. A focused pilot on one workflow is usually measured in weeks, not months. We agree the timeline and the success measures in writing at the end of discovery.

items.q: Can you work with our existing systems?
a: Yes. We connect to the tools you already use, including Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Salesforce, ticketing systems, databases and custom APIs. We prefer to add AI to your current stack rather than replace it.

items.q: Which smart glasses do you support?
a: We build apps for Meta, XREAL, Snap Spectacles and MentraOS glasses. The right device depends on whether you need a display, a camera, all-day battery or a rugged frame. We help you choose before any hardware is bought.

items.q: How do you handle security and confidentiality?
a: We sign a mutual NDA before we see sensitive material, follow your access rules and keep data in the environment we agree with you. Every agent action is logged so you can review what happened and why.

items.q: Do you work with companies outside India?
a: Yes. We work with clients in India and abroad. Discovery workshops can run on site or remotely, and our team works across time zones to fit your schedule.

Cost depends on the scope, the number of systems involved and whether hardware such as smart glasses is needed. Discovery is a short fixed-price engagement. After discovery we give you a fixed quote for the pilot, so you know the cost before you commit to building.

You do. Code, models trained on your data, prompts and documentation built for your project belong to you once the work is paid for. We can also hand over the full setup to your internal team with training.

items.q: What if AI is not the right answer for our process?
a: Then we will tell you. Some processes are better fixed with a simple rule, a form or a change in how work is assigned. A clear no in discovery saves you far more than a pilot that was never going to work.
